# How to Place Bulk Bag Orders from India – A Complete Export Guide

- [vdcuo](https://greenobag.com/author/vdcuo/)
- [December 30, 2025](https://greenobag.com/2025/12/30/)

![](https://greenobag.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/GreenoBag.png)

With the global demand for eco-friendly and reusable bags growing exponentially, retailers, wholesalers, and importers across the globe are increasingly turning to India as their go-to source for high-quality, sustainable bag options. Whether you are sourcing cotton tote bags, jute shopping bags, or canvas pouches, India offers competitive pricing, massive production capacity, and an unmatched legacy of craftsmanship.

At [Greenobag](https://www.greenobag.com/), we’ve worked with clients across the USA, Europe, Japan, the Middle East, and Australia to help them place smooth, successful, and timely bulk orders. If you’re new to importing bags from India, this guide walks you through the entire process step-by-step, making your journey efficient and hassle-free.

Let’s dive into the essential stages of placing bulk bag orders from India.

## **Why Source Bulk Bags from India?**

India has become a global powerhouse in manufacturing eco-friendly and sustainable bags. Several factors contribute to this rise:

- Rich availability of natural fibers like cotton, jute, and canvas
- Cost-effective skilled labor and large-scale manufacturing capacity
- Long-standing textile heritage with a focus on sustainability
- Export-friendly policies and well-connected shipping infrastructure
- In-house design and customization capabilities

India’s ability to produce bags that are functional, stylish, affordable, and environmentally responsible makes it a preferred destination for bulk buyers worldwide.

## **Step 1: Define Your Bag Requirements**

Before reaching out to a manufacturer, it’s important to identify your needs clearly. This includes:

- Type of bags: cotton tote, jute shopping, drawstring pouches, or canvas organizers
- Bag size and shape: standard, large, gusseted, foldable, zipped, etc.
- Fabric quality: regular cotton, organic cotton, juco blend, laminated jute
- Quantity: minimum order quantity and expected repeat volumes
- Customization: printing, logo, color, handle type, packaging
- Delivery timeline: event date, seasonal deadlines, stock planning

Having these requirements documented makes the communication with the supplier more efficient and reduces the chance of confusion or rework.

## **Step 2: Research and Shortlist Indian Bag Manufacturers**

Next, look for [reputed Indian bag suppliers](https://www.greenobag.com/about-us) who specialize in eco bag exports. Here are some parameters to evaluate:

- Years of experience in bag manufacturing and exporting
- Export certifications such as ISO, SEDEX, or GOTS
- In-house manufacturing capacity and daily production output
- Product range and portfolio
- Customization and design assistance capabilities
- Export history to your country or region

You can search for manufacturers on B2B platforms, export directories, or directly connect with companies like Greenobag that have a strong global presence and credibility.

## **Step 3: Request a Quote and Product Catalog**

Once you’ve shortlisted one or more suppliers, request the following:

- Digital product catalog with specifications and material details
- Minimum order quantity (MOQ)
- Pricing breakdown based on quantity and customization
- Lead time for production and shipping
- Payment terms and sample policy

Share your bag requirements upfront so that the supplier can send a quote tailored to your order. Greenobag provides a comprehensive quotation that includes pricing, custom options, sample terms, and delivery schedule.

## **Step 4: Ask for Samples Before Final Order**

Before placing a bulk order, it is always advisable to review a physical sample. This helps confirm:

- Bag quality and strength
- Stitching finish and dimensions
- Print clarity and color accuracy
- Handle durability and placement
- Branding elements such as tags or logos

Some manufacturers offer free samples while others charge a nominal sample cost which is adjusted in the final order. At Greenobag, clients can request customized samples based on their designs and receive them within a few days.

## **Step 5: Finalize the Order and Place the Purchase**

Once the sample meets your expectations, you can proceed with finalizing the order. This involves:

- Confirming total quantity and product specifications
- Signing a purchase order or agreement with detailed T&Cs
- Making advance payment (usually 30 to 50 percent)
- Sharing finalized artwork files and branding elements
- Receiving an estimated delivery schedule

Make sure all communication is documented, and timelines are agreed upon to maintain transparency and trust.

## **Step 6: Bag Production and Quality Checks**

The supplier will now begin the [manufacturing process](https://www.greenobag.com/manufacturing). A good manufacturer will have the following stages in their production workflow:

- Fabric selection, dyeing, and cutting
- Printing and customization
- Stitching and assembling
- Quality inspection and finishing
- Labeling and packaging

At Greenobag, our facility operates with a capacity of producing up to 150,000 bags per day. Every batch undergoes multi-stage quality control before moving to dispatch. Clients can request production updates or even third-party inspection, if required.

## **Step 7: Packaging, Labeling, and Documentation**

Bulk orders are then packed according to the buyer’s packaging preferences. Standard practices include:

- Packing bags in bundles using recycled polybags or paper wraps
- Placing bundles inside export cartons with labels
- Including barcodes, hang tags, or branding inserts
- Labeling with SKU, quantity, country of origin, and handling instructions

Export-related documentation is also prepared at this stage, including:

- Commercial Invoice
- Packing List
- Bill of Lading or Airway Bill
- Certificate of Origin
- Phytosanitary or GSP documents (as needed)

These documents are essential for customs clearance at your end.

## **Step 8: Shipping and Logistics**

Buyers can choose between different shipping methods:

- Sea Freight: Ideal for large quantities, lower cost, but longer transit (20–40 days)
- Air Freight: Faster delivery (5–10 days), slightly more expensive
- Courier Services: Only suitable for small volumes or urgent samples

Shipping terms are usually defined as:

- FOB (Free on Board): Buyer arranges shipping from port
- CIF (Cost, Insurance & Freight): Supplier handles shipping and insurance
- DDP (Delivered Duty Paid): Supplier manages all logistics and customs until delivery

Greenobag offers flexible shipping solutions and works with trusted freight partners to deliver on-time globally.

## **Step 9: Customs Clearance and Delivery**

Once the shipment reaches your port, it will go through customs clearance. You may need to coordinate with:

- A licensed customs broker or agent
- Relevant import permits and product classification codes
- Payment of import duties or GST (as applicable)

Once cleared, the cargo will be delivered to your warehouse, retail store, or fulfillment center. Make sure to inspect the shipment on arrival and report any discrepancies immediately.

## **Step 10: Reordering and Building a Long-Term Relationship**

Once your bulk order is successfully completed, keep the communication open for future orders. A good supplier will retain your preferences, provide faster turnaround on repeat orders, and even help with product development based on market feedback.

At Greenobag, our long-standing clients enjoy priority access to new designs, special pricing, and direct support from our export team. We believe that consistency, transparency, and shared values build long-term partnerships.

## **Tips for a Smooth Bulk Order Experience**

- Clearly communicate expectations and artwork specifications
- Be realistic with timelines; allow for production and shipping buffers
- Use a sample approval process to avoid surprises
- Choose a certified and experienced export house
- Factor in all costs: product price, shipping, customs, and last-mile delivery
- Maintain all written records of approval, changes, and payments

Placing a bulk bag order from India doesn’t have to be overwhelming. With the right planning, a trustworthy supplier, and clear communication, the process can be seamless and profitable. Whether you’re a retail brand, promotional product company, or wholesale distributor, India’s combination of eco-conscious materials, manufacturing expertise, and export capabilities makes it the smart sourcing destination.
